title: Yo Is Emphasis In Practice
voice_notes: Warm, patient teacher. One voice. Brian v3. English prompts use language_code en; Spanish reveals use language_code es. Avoid Language Transfer branding.

segments.say: Do not say yo every time English says I.
But Spanish usually leaves it out, because the verb already tells you who.
segments.show:
the verb already
tells you who

segments.say: Use yo when you want to stress who is doing it: I want it, not someone else.
segments.show:
I want it
not someone else

segments.say: That is not just neutral I want. It is more like me, I want.
Say I want, with that me, not them feeling.
For the negative, no still goes right before quiero.
Say: I do not want, with emphasis.
Use yo when you are contrasting, correcting, or making your own choice clear.

caption: Quiero already means I want. Use yo when you are contrasting, correcting, or making your own choice clear.
